verdicts.reason: Explicitly rejects the 18-inch parapet as adequate protection and specifies edge guardrails, restraint, or properly designed personal fall-arrest systems.
Treats skylights as openings and requires secured, load-rated screens/covers or guardrails around skylights exposed to work and access routes.
Addresses rated rigging, qualified signal person, exclusion zones, crane capacity, and wind stop-work limits based on equipment instructions and site conditions.
Controls explicitly follow hierarchy order; written rescue planning includes trained rescuers, equipment, anchors, communications, EMS access, and prompt casualty retrieval.
Requires competent-person review and approval before work, provides an approval field, and uses the verification placeholder without citing regulation section numbers.
